top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Equipment - Allows Children To Fall Inside Structure Onto Other Parts (26 TAC §746.4603(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the evidence obtained, a child was playing on monkey bars during outdoor play which resulted into an injury.

top_violation_types.title: Reporting Suspected Abuse, Neglect, Exploitation-May not delegate responsibility to report (26 TAC §746.201(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During a DFPS investigation, it was found that the operation staff was notified of possible abuse against a child in care and the operation did not report to licensing.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily (26 TAC §746.4751(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The documentation provided indicates that the center has not been completing its weekly and monthly maintenance outdoor checks.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The school age building still had a broken electrical outlet in the library center.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver did not wash their hands after changing a child's diaper.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.
